description: Smoke coverage for scripts/codebase_explorer.py — the main arbitrary-repo intake/diagnosis path. Three tiny fixture repos (Python/Rust/Go) prove CodebaseExplorer can ingest a repo, detect language + build system, run shadow build/test, surface at least one issue signal, AND do so without mutating source, corpus, or signed evidence, without requiring T:/, and without weakening safety defaults.
purpose: First test coverage for the largest untested module in the repo. Establishes a regression floor for the arbitrary-repo intake path. Does NOT redesign codebase_explorer — that is the next rung (BUILD_ADAPTER_REGISTRY_LOCK_001).
test_coverage: status tokens form a closed set, matched to lock manifest
codebase_explorer module imports cleanly (SSRF guard at import time passes)
no drive letter required to locate fixtures
python_broken: pip + pytest detected, test_failure finding surfaced, source tree unmutated, signed evidence unmutated
rust_broken: cargo + cargo test detected, compilation finding surfaced (cargo check rejects), source tree unmutated (Cargo.lock treated as build cruft)
go_broken: go + go test detected, compilation or test_failure finding surfaced, source tree unmutated
no-drive-letter intake: DETERMINEX_*/HF_HOME/OLLAMA_* stripped, WorkspaceLoader still detects language
corpus write guard is in effect during smoke (DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE=1 → CorpusWriteBlockedError)
safety defaults remain fail-closed after a smoke run (assert_safety_defaults returns [])
lock manifest status tokens match module STATUS_TOKENS

fixtures.name: python_broken
fixtures.issue: src/calc.py::add subtracts instead of adds; tests/test_calc.py asserts 2+3==5 → pytest fails

fixtures.name: rust_broken
fixtures.issue: src/lib.rs::add returns a string literal from a fn declared i32 → cargo check rejects with E0308
fixtures.toolchain_dependency: cargo must be on PATH (test skipped otherwise)

fixtures.name: go_broken
fixtures.issue: calc/calc.go::Add returns "oops" from a signature declared int → go build rejects
fixtures.toolchain_dependency: go must be on PATH (test skipped otherwise)

modules_NOT_covered_in_this_lock: IssueLocalizer (requires LLM mock — deferred to next rung)
PatchPipeline (requires LLM mock — deferred to next rung)
main / CLI dispatch (covered indirectly via subprocess call from frontend IPC, not unit-tested here)

safety_invariants: Fixture is copied to a tmp_path before exploration; the git-tracked fixture is never mutated.
SOURCE_TREE_UNMUTATED hash compares before/after the COPY, ignoring tool-generated build cruft (Cargo.lock, go.sum, __pycache__/, target/, .pytest_cache/).
EVIDENCE_UNMUTATED_EXCEPT_LOCK_RECORD hashes assurance/evidence/evidence_index.json + every locks/sentinel/*.json before and after each per-fixture explore.
DETERMINEX_NO_CORPUS_WRITE=1 is set in the test env; any corpus write would raise CorpusWriteBlockedError.
DETERMINEX_AUDIT_DIR is redirected to the tmp_path so observability events never touch real logs.
DETERMINEX_OLLAMA_URL is pinned to http://localhost:11434 to satisfy codebase_explorer's import-time SSRF guard.
DETERMINEX_TEST_TIMEOUT=45 caps every shadow subprocess so a wedge fails fast.
No network access: shadow build/test runs only the local toolchains (cargo, go, py_compile, pytest).
No model/API calls (the LLM-dependent diagnose/fix paths are excluded from this lock).
remaining_gaps_in_codebase_explorer: No tests for IssueLocalizer, PatchPipeline, diagnose(), or fix() — all require LLM mocking. Deferred to a future LLM-mocked-intake lock.
Build-system detection is still a 14-line if-ladder in detect_build_system; no adapter contract. This is the explicit subject of the next rung, BUILD_ADAPTER_REGISTRY_LOCK_001.
ShadowCompiler shells out via raw subprocess.run; it does not route through hive/compiler.py's hardened sandbox / Job Objects. To be addressed by PARALLEL_EXECUTION_LAYER_AUDIT_LOCK_001.
MAX_SCAN_FILES=5000 silently truncates large repos — no warning is surfaced in the WorkspaceReport.
Stale model id defaults are still hardcoded at codebase_explorer.py:58-59 (engineer-v10-dsl / observer-v5-dsl). To be addressed by MODEL_ROUTER_LOCK_001.
No incremental indexing — every explore() call rescans the whole repo.
No symbol cross-ref / LSP-style index — diagnose() is keyword + traceback parsing only.
